sum: The underlying index is a subset of the Russell 2000® Index, which measures the performance of the small-capitalization sector of the U.S. equity market, as defined by Russell. The fund may use derivatives to gain or reduce exposure to the components of the underlying index or exposure to one or more market risk factors associated with such components.
